paragraphs.text: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
paragraphs.original: Ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι, ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος, σκοπῶν σεαυτόν, μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς.
paragraphs.translit: Adelphoi, ean kai prolēmphthē anthrōpos en tini paraptōmati, hymeis hoi pneumatikoi katartizete ton toiouton en pneumati prautētos, skopōn seauton, mē kai sy peirasthēs.

paragraphs.text: Bear ye one another`s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε, καὶ οὕτως ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: allēlōn ta barē bastazete, kai houtōs anaplērōsete ton nomon tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ δοκεῖ τις εἶναί τι μηδὲν ὤν, φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν·
paragraphs.translit: ei gar dokei tis einai ti mēden ōn, phrenapata heauton·

paragraphs.text: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.
paragraphs.original: τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος, καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ καύχημα ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον,
paragraphs.translit: to de ergon heautou dokimazetō hekastos, kai tote eis heauton monon to kauchēma hexei kai ouk eis ton heteron,

paragraphs.text: For each man shall bear his own burden.
paragraphs.original: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον βαστάσει.
paragraphs.translit: hekastos gar to idion phortion bastasei.

paragraphs.text: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
paragraphs.original: Κοινωνείτω δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον τῷ κατηχοῦντι ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: Koinōneitō de ho katēchoumenos ton logon tō katēchounti en pasin agathois.

paragraphs.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
paragraphs.original: μὴ πλανᾶσθε, θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται· ὃ γὰρ ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος, τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει·
paragraphs.translit: mē planasthe, theos ou myktērizetai· ho gar ean speirē anthrōpos, touto kai therisei·

paragraphs.text: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἑαυτοῦ ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν, ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ho speirōn eis tēn sarka heautou ek tēs sarkos therisei phthoran, ho de speirōn eis to pneuma ek tou pneumatos therisei zōēn aiōnion.

paragraphs.text: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
paragraphs.original: τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ἐγκακῶμεν, καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι.
paragraphs.translit: to de kalon poiountes mē enkakōmen, kairō gar idiō therisomen mē eklyomenoi.

paragraphs.text: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.
paragraphs.original: ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ἔχομεν, ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας, μάλιστα δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως.
paragraphs.translit: ara oun hōs kairon echomen, ergazōmetha to agathon pros pantas, malista de pros tous oikeious tēs pisteōs.

paragraphs.text: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.
paragraphs.original: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις ὑμῖν γράμμασιν ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί.
paragraphs.translit: Idete pēlikois hymin grammasin egrapsa tē emē cheiri.

paragraphs.text: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί, οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι, μόνον ἵνα τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Χριστοῦ μὴ διώκωνται·
paragraphs.translit: hosoi thelousin euprosōpēsai en sarki, houtoi anankazousin hymas peritemnesthai, monon hina tō staurō tou Christou mē diōkōntai·

paragraphs.text: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ περιτεμνόμενοι αὐτοὶ νόμον φυλάσσουσιν, ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα ἐν τῇ ὑμετέρᾳ σαρκὶ καυχήσωνται.
paragraphs.translit: oude gar hoi peritemnomenoi autoi nomon phylassousin, alla thelousin hymas peritemnesthai hina en tē hymetera sarki kauchēsōntai.

paragraphs.text: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
paragraphs.original: ἐμοὶ δὲ μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, διʼ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται κἀγὼ κόσμῳ.
paragraphs.translit: emoi de mē genoito kauchasthai ei mē en tō staurō tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou, diʼ hou emoi kosmos estaurōtai kagō kosmō.

paragraphs.text: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
paragraphs.original: οὔτε γὰρ περιτομή τί ἐστιν οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις.
paragraphs.translit: oute gar peritomē ti estin oute akrobystia, alla kainē ktisis.

paragraphs.text: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace [be] upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅσοι τῷ κανόνι τούτῳ στοιχήσουσιν, εἰρήνη ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλεος, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hosoi tō kanoni toutō stoichēsousin, eirēnē epʼ autous kai eleos, kai epi ton Israēl tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Henceforth, let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.
paragraphs.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ κόπους μοι μηδεὶς παρεχέτω, ἐγὼ γὰρ τὰ στίγματα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματί μου βαστάζω.
paragraphs.translit: Tou loipou kopous moi mēdeis parechetō, egō gar ta stigmata tou Iēsou en tō sōmati mou bastazō.

paragraphs.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: Hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta tou pneumatos hymōn, adelphoi· amēn.
